items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: one of my protégés, like the young Olympians, who are the soul rebels

ctx.x: You know what I'm saying? I went back to the old fireman's cap, which was used in the early days for the circus band and the other bands that performed. And to me, musicians should be dressed. All the time be dressed. And I stress this with my band up to today. Don't come on my bandstand and don't come with me on a parade. If you're not dressed the way I ask you to dress.
